description: This PHP class 'TerminationReasonConfigurationService' provides service-layer methods for managing termination reasons in an HRM system. It interacts with a DAO to perform CRUD operations, search, and validation related to termination reasons.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class for handling termination reason configurations, coordinating between controller and DAO layer, providing methods for CRUD operations, search, and validation.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance managing termination reasons, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance, allowing dependency injection for testing or customization.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a TerminationReason entity to the database via DAO.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason entity by its name.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching the provided search filter.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons with specified IDs from the database.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason name already exists in the database.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of termination reasons that are currently in use.
